season.source: The stored 'not year-round' was derived from note prose ('Open ~April-October'). Larimer County's pages contradict it without stating Inlet Bay's own season: the county prices electric campsites at Horsetooth for 'October – March' ($25/$30) and the booking site's rate table runs Non Peak Season Oct 01 2026 - Mar 31 2027 for STANDARD ELECTRIC; 'Water available at frost free spigots only from Nov-March'; the reservoir 'is open year round'. Cleared rather than replaced. https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/permits + larimercamping.com, read 2026-10-27

values.note: Larimer County's ReserveAmerica site (larimercamping.com; Inlet Bay is a loop of the Horsetooth Reservoir park) or 1-800-397-7795. Same-day bookings online 24/7 or at a park office; walk-ups book by QR code at the site - 'Campers MUST make a reservation and purchase a park entrance permit BEFORE setting up'. Two-night minimum for weekend dates April through September; 14 nights in any 30 days across the county system.

booking.source: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/reservations/campgrounds (Reservation Policies: 'A two-night reservation is required for weekend dates April through September at all campsites', 'Maximum stay is 14 days in any 30-day period', 'Sites can be reserved up to 180 days in advance'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Inlet Bay has electric sites only: April-September $35 a night weekdays, $45 weekends, $55 holidays; October-March $25 weekdays, $30 weekends. (The $45-65 full-hookup sites are at South Bay.) $8.75 reservation fee per stay. Daily entrance permit $10 per vehicle ($20 with a boat trailer), or a Larimer County annual permit.

fees.source: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/permits ('Electric campsite (April – September) $35 $45 $55', 'Electric campsite (October – March) $25 $30 n/a', 'Full hookups campsite – Horsetooth Reservoir ... $45 $60 $65'; daily permit 'Carter Lake, Flatiron, Pinewood and Horsetooth reservoirs $10/vehicle ... or $20/vehicle and boat trailer'), read 2026-10-27

note: Larimer County campground on the SW shore of Horsetooth Reservoir near Fort Collins; sites strung along the lake edge in two loops with Inlet Bay Marina between them. --Claude
summary: Inlet Bay is one loop of Larimer County's Horsetooth Reservoir park on larimercamping.com: 54 sites, all 50-amp electric, none with water or sewer (the 17 full-hookup sites are South Bay's) - set electric 50, cleared derived water/sewer true; sites 54, max 60 ft, pull-throughs; vault toilets + drinking water; fees corrected to the electric-site rate $35/$45 (was $35-60, which mixed in South Bay's full hookups) plus $10/vehicle entrance permit; booking ReserveAmerica, 180 days, reservation required, 2-night weekend minimum Apr-Sep, 14-night max; derived 'not year-round' cleared (county prices Oct-Mar camping at Horsetooth). Pin is 0.25 km from the site centroid (40.52519,-105.16283): fine. Open now; no closure notice. Booking site marks 39 of 54 sites 'Near Water', consistent with stored lakefront.
flags: Horsetooth Reservoir has no other drive-in RV campground: the county lists only South Bay (2652), Inlet Bay and boat-in sites (larimer.gov reservations page; the booking site's Horsetooth park holds South Bay 78 sites, Inlet Bay 54, South Bay Cabins 5, 10 boat-in sites and 2 pavilions).
